definition.method: Calculate divergence between two agent state vectors generated via randomized input sequences with and without memory persistence. Persistence mediates the accumulation of history; non-persistence resets history to instantaneous input. We expect divergence (measured as 1 - cosine similarity of normalized vectors) to exceed the noise floor.
definition.stop: After computing the divergence score for the given seed pair.
definition.success: Completion of calculation and return of divergence_score.

definition.reason: Attention on divergent_values requires verifying the hypothesis hyp-divergent-values-003 via controlled empirical testing.
definition.uncertainty: The magnitude of divergence threshold (0.35) is an assumption derived from preliminary notebook analysis; experimental data is needed to calibrate this threshold.
